_note: Fictional requests from Northwind SaaS, a fictional company. Roles only, no names. One request contains a fictional IBAN and one a fictional customer list, to show redaction.

requests.title: Summarise customer calls into next steps
requests.text: We spend hours summarising customer calls. Four of us each spend 90 minutes a week writing notes after calls and copying next steps into HubSpot, and follow-ups still get lost. Could AI turn the call notes into tasks with owners?

requests.title: Turn call notes into follow-up tasks
requests.text: After discovery calls our reps forget follow-ups. Could AI turn call notes into follow-up tasks with owners? Roughly 3 hours a week per rep, 6 reps each.

requests.title: AI for emails?
requests.text: Can we use AI for emails?

requests.title: Answer handbook questions in Slack
requests.text: New joiners ask the same questions in Slack about expenses, remote work and the AI policy. I answer them for about 5 hours a week. Answers should come from our Notion handbook and say which page they used.

requests.title: Rank job applicants automatically
requests.text: Score the CVs we get for the junior designer role and shortlist the top 10 candidates, so we save 8 hours a week of screening.

requests.title: Match supplier invoices to payments
requests.text: Every month I match supplier invoices to bank payments by hand. Example: the invoice from Brightpath Ltd was paid to IBAN DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00 but the reference was wrong. It takes about 12 hours a month.

requests.title: Social posts for every release
requests.text: For every product release we need Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok posts. Writing captions for each network and scheduling them takes about 4 hours a week.

requests.title: Morning briefing of the support inbox
requests.text: Our shared support inbox gets about 300 emails a week. A morning briefing of what's urgent, plus draft replies we can edit, would save me about 5 hours a week.

requests.title: Split the Q1 paid media budget
requests.text: Plan how to split €40,000 across Google, LinkedIn and Meta next quarter and forecast the CPA for each. It takes me two full days every quarter.

requests.title: See which competitor ads keep running
requests.text: Before our spring campaign I want to know which competitors' ads on Meta have been running the longest. I spend about 3 hours a week on manual ad research.

requests.title: Auto-reply to every support ticket
requests.text: Use AI to automatically send replies to customers without anyone checking them, so we always hit the 4-hour first response target. It would save the team about 10 hours a week.

requests.title: Clean up our customer list
requests.text: Here is part of our customer list to de-duplicate: anna.ribeiro@lumen.example, +351 912 345 678, jorge@cobalt.example, jorge.m@cobalt.example. Fixing duplicates in HubSpot takes about 3 hours a week.

requests.title: Bot that answers policy questions from Notion
requests.text: A Slack bot that answers handbook questions from our Notion pages and says which page it used. New joiners ask the same policy questions every week, about 4 hours a week of answering.

requests.title: Track agent productivity
requests.text: Monitor how many tickets each agent closes and flag the slowest agents to their manager every Friday. About 2 hours a week of spreadsheets today.

requests.title: Translate help centre articles
requests.text: We have 120 help articles in English. Customers in Spain and Portugal ask for Spanish and Portuguese versions. Translating and keeping them updated takes about 6 hours a week.

requests.title: Something with AI for finance
requests.text: Can we use AI in finance somehow?

requests.title: Release notes from Asana tasks
requests.text: Each release I write customer-facing release notes from about 30 Asana tasks. It takes about 2 hours a week. Could AI draft them from the task titles and descriptions?

requests.title: Find out-of-date handbook pages
requests.text: Some of our Notion handbook pages contradict each other (the home office budget is €500 on one page and €300 on another) and some are years old. Flag pages that are out of date or conflict. About 2 hours a week of checking.

requests.title: LinkedIn posts for sales reps
requests.text: Our reps want to share two LinkedIn posts a week about customer stories. Each of the 8 reps spends about 1 hour a week writing them.

requests.title: Monthly board report numbers
requests.text: Every month I pull MRR and churn from HubSpot into a slide for the board. It takes about 6 hours a month and copy-paste mistakes happen.
